quote: Whenever lights are displayed upon a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway, such lights shall be depressed or dimmed, in the event cowl or parking lamps are not used.

activation.condition: Lights displayed on a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon a highway while cowl and parking lamps are not used.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Displayed-light state requires original lamp telemetry.
Parking lawfulness requires separate highway and parking context sources.
Night and highway status require independent original sources.
Beam state must be observed without inventing a numeric legal cutoff.
Auxiliary lamp use is separate from displayed beam state.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: cowl or parking lamps are not used

obligation.description: Displayed lights shall be depressed or dimmed in the stated conditions.

timing.description: Original parked interval and lamp-state history.
